exposure: maternal excess weight during early pregnancy
accelerated weight gain in the first 2 years
outcome: Body Mass Index (BMI) at 2 years of age
body fat percentage at 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 109 mother-child pairs from whom data were collected from early pregnancy until the child was 2 years old.
finding: The presence of several early risk factors related to obesity in infancy, including maternal excess weight, gestational smoking, accelerated weight gain in the first 2 years, and pre-pregnancy BMI, was significantly associated with higher BMI z-score and body fat percentage at 2 years of age.
